|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Aatrox''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|4 + (10-4)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}, capped at {{pp|100 + (320-100)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1}} against {{tip|monsters}}. ''Deathbringer Stance's'' damage applies {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.<br><br>'''Aatrox''' {{tip|heals}} for <!--{{ap|{{#var:i_hmod}}*100}}% of -->the {{tt|post-mitigation '''bonus''' damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt, reduced to {{ap|{{#var:i_mhmod}}*{{#var:i_hmod}}*100}}% against {{tip|minions}}.
|description2 = Whenever '''Aatrox''' hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}} with a basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} or an {{tip|ability}}, ''Deathbringer Stance's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 2 seconds, doubled to 4 if he hits with the {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} of ''{{ai|The Darkin Blade|Aatrox}}''.

|notes        =
* '''Aatrox''' will assume stance when an enemy champion is in range of {{ai|Infernal Chains|Aatrox}}.
** The [[Emoting|toggle]] expression (default {{sbc|CTRL + 5}}) switches between stances manually.
* If ''Deathbringer Stance'' becomes available during a standard attack's windup, it will not be consumed or trigger the '''bonus''' damage.
* Even if the ability hit is {{tip|spell shield|spell shielded}} ''Deathbringer Stance's'' cooldown will still be reduced.
* This ability goes on cooldown on death and refreshes upon respawn.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|wards}}.
